source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved Save & Exit page field or transaction commits the intended NVRAM changes, performs the documented exit/reset behavior and leaves boot, security and management state consistent with the selected action.
original_method: Use a named sentinel BIOS field with a known baseline and approved non-default value, then manually invoke one precisely identified Save & Exit action, observe confirmation/reset behavior, and verify the intended commit and persistence after reboot before restoring the final state.
manual_activity: An engineer must select the named firmware transaction, interpret any confirmation dialog, observe exit/reset behavior and visually verify the sentinel value afterward. Automated NVRAM/boot evidence is supporting only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC identity and exact Save & Exit page/action labels
Named harmless sentinel field, original value, approved changed value and SPEC default
Expected reboot path, boot/security invariants and NVRAM scope
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or click an unspecified Save, Discard, Reset, Default or Exit command.
Use one harmless sentinel field; do not combine boot, security-key, storage-mode or recovery-critical edits unless separately scoped.
Capture the full pending-change list and confirmation text before committing.
Do not infer success from reboot alone; verify the intended value and unchanged protected state.
Stop on unexpected commit/discard, extra reset, boot/security change or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware identity, exposed UEFI/NVRAM metadata, boot/security state, reboot timestamps, logs and BMC health around operator phases.
Compare the documented sentinel and protected-state expectations without editing variables.
Do not drive BIOS, choose menu transactions, edit NVRAM or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact action, sentinel, expected dialog/transaction/reset and recovery.
Perform and capture the single action lifecycle and visually verify the post-reboot value.
Interpret transaction and system-health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote BIOS execution, but its generic settings wording does not distinguish a persistent field from a transaction command.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the BIOS workflow and add read-only transaction-correlated NVRAM, boot, security, reset and management evidence; do not substitute OS variable writes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random is narrowed only for safe project execution, not rewritten in source.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define each Save/Exit/Reset action as a transaction with pre-state, one sentinel pending change, confirmation text, reset/exit event, expected post-state and protected invariants; test only the selected action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS UI and NVRAM implementation for the selected build.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, UEFI variable tooling and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random page operations with one attributable sentinel and explicit transaction semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves commit/persistence intent and adds confirmation, reset and protected-state checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Action schema, sentinel, expected transaction, invariants and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read-only OS NVRAM visibility is incomplete and cannot prove UI confirmation or all firmware variables.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose a specific Save & Exit action and harmless sentinel. Results must identify that action and cannot claim other Save/Discard/Reset commands were covered.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, action/sentinel matrix, protected-state baseline, approval and recovery
Pre-action value, pending-change list and confirmation-dialog capture
Observed exit/reset/reboot sequence and post-reboot sentinel result
Boot/security/NVRAM and management invariants plus anomaly logs
Approved final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is generic but consistently seeks saved persistence and default comparison. Exact action and sentinel are project readiness inputs rather than an explicit contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The transaction intent is understandable. A named action and sentinel must be supplied before execution, but the reusable master case is not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual operation and corrects its treatment of transaction commands as ordinary settings.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its NVRAM/boot/security evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines attributable transaction semantics and rejects generic menu clicks or OS NVRAM edits as substitutes.

review_improvement: Makes commit behavior provable with one sentinel and protects against accidentally exercising Discard, Reset or Load Default while reporting generic persistence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core acceptance is a human-selected firmware transaction and visual confirmation. Automated evidence can support but cannot perform or interpret that UI workflow, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat Save/Exit/Reset transactions or recovery after an unexpected commit, discard, reset, boot or management result; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
